MAJOR: `authorityReasonCode` now relies on string-marker matching alone to distinguish exhaustion/timeout/schema failure; the delta hardens matching for `x509:` but adds no structured `errors.As`/SQLSTATE-based classification, so reason codes remain sensitive to driver message wording changes (AC-1 bounded-reason integrity at risk over time).
MINOR: The new test cases (`result/x509:`, `result=x509:`, `X509: uppercase`) assert classification only via the bounded-reason helper; no test asserts the resulting gauge label set stays bounded/low-cardinality, leaving the AC-1 cardinality guarantee unpinned by the delta.
Adding broader `x509` substring matching risks classifying unrelated errors containing that token as `db_unavailable`, masking genuine `internal_error` conditions and weakening failure diagnosis.
NIT: Consider naming the marker table/constant so future marker additions are reviewed in one place rather than inline regex/substring checks.
SUMMARY: Delta is a small, safe hardening of reason-code normalization; prior uppercase-`X509` blocker appears resolved via explicit lowercasing.
Residual risk: classification remains message-string dependent (brittle across driver/version changes) and the low-cardinality gauge guarantee is not directly asserted.
No new data-loss, security, or tenant-isolation defects introduced in this delta.
